name: Account Request Submitted
description: Sent to a requester to confirm that their account request has been submitted successfully.
subject: $data.sourceName – $data.operationType request submitted for $data.accountName
body:
Account Request Submitted

Hello $data.requesterName,

Your request to $data.operationType.toLowerCase() the account $data.accountName on $data.sourceName was submitted successfully.

Request details

  • Action: $data.operationType.toLowerCase()
  • Account: $data.accountName
  • Source: $data.sourceName

To view the status of your request, go to: ${__global.productUrl}/ui/d/my-requests/account-requests. You will receive a notification once this request has been completed.

Thank you,
The $__global.productName Team
